detail: cfg_scale=7 alone (without --hq) adopted composite 58.5 vs cfg=5 baseline of 56.0. BUT superseded: cfg=5+hq=true reaches 62.98 — --hq is the real lever. With hq on, cfg=5 is optimal (cfg=7+hq not tested but cfg=5+hq wins on available data).
audio_cfg_scale=3.0 consistently regresses voice_score vs default (5.0). Confirmed dead-end across multiple sweeps including run 20260620_130253 — do not retry.

LTX-2.3 dasiwa audio composite ceiling raised to 69.12 (run 20260620_130253) with config: stage1=20, stage2=5, cfg=5, stg_scale=1.5, modality_scale=5, hq=true, seed=42. Prior ceiling was ~63.93. Audio-knob sweeps (cfg-scale, stage1-only) cannot break the voice.snr ceiling but structural knobs (stg_scale, step counts) do help. Next lever candidates: av_ca speech-gate in vendor_patches.py (currently 1000.0).

SUPERSEDED: stage1_steps=20 was ADOPTED in run 20260620_130253 (composite 69.12) and stage2_steps=5 also adopted. Original finding was context-specific (no modality_scale=5 foundation). With hq+modality_scale=5 as baseline, step overrides CAN help. Only stage1_steps=25 with low_ram+hq remains dangerous (FileNotFoundError crash).

LTX-2.3 dasiwa BEST confirmed config (2026-06-20 run 20260620_130253): cfg_scale=5, stg_scale=1.5, hq=true, stage1_steps=20, stage2_steps=5, modality_scale=5, seed=42, composite=69.12. Config key: 20/5/cfg5/stg1.5/acfgnull/modsca5/s1ofalse/hqtrue/seed42. Prior best was 63.93 (stg_scale=1.0, stage1=15, stage2=3). 25 frames sufficient for quality judgment.

audio-stage1-only mode gives slight edge over full audio generation for dasiwa/LTX-2.3 in naturalness, but cannot break the ~60% composite ceiling. Re-sweeping with hq=true confirmed no further gain (composite stayed at 62.98). CONFIRMED-CEILING.

--hq (TI2VidTwoStagesHQPipeline, res_2s second-order Runge-Kutta sampler) is the primary quality lever for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Raises composite 58.5→62.98 (+4.5) at cfg=5+stage1=15. Fixes quality.edge (was 17-31, now not weakest). New weakest: voice.snr=4.8 dB. --hq is now dasiwa CLI default. Not compatible with --distilled.

modality_scale=5 adopted in run 20260620_120410: pushed composite to 63.93 on dasiwa/LTX-2.3 (hq=true, cfg=5, stage1=15, stage2=3, seed=42). Still active in 20260620_130253 as part of best config (composite 69.12). modality_scale=2 consistently regressed — only value 5 is beneficial so far.

modality_scale=2 regresses composite vs modality_scale=5 for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Tried in run 20260620_120410 and confirmed dead-end again in 20260620_130253. Consistently yields ~59.96 vs 63.93+ at scale=5. Do not retry modality_scale=2.

stg_scale=1.5 adopted in run 20260620_130253 (iteration 2): pushed composite 63.93→66.61 on dasiwa/LTX-2.3 (hq=true, cfg=5, stage2=5, modality_scale=5, seed=42). Prior default stg_scale=1.0 confirmed optimal in A/B test, but 1.5 outperforms on the modality_scale=5+stage2=5 foundation. stg_scale=2 is a dead-end (regresses).
stg_scale=2 regresses composite for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Confirmed dead-end in run 20260620_130253 (iteration 3, not adopted). stg_scale=1.5 is the current sweet spot — going to 2 is harmful.

stage2_steps=5 adopted in run 20260620_130253 (iteration 1, composite 63.93 on that step). Part of the final best config achieving composite 69.12. stage2_steps=5 vs default 3 improves refinement quality for dasiwa/LTX-2.3 when hq=true and modality_scale=5.

stage1_steps=20 adopted in run 20260620_130253 (iteration 4): pushed composite 66.61→69.12 on dasiwa/LTX-2.3 (hq=true, cfg=5, stg_scale=1.5, stage2=5, modality_scale=5, seed=42). Contradicts prior avoid record (ltx:step-count-regression) which was based on a different baseline. When building on hq+modality_scale=5 foundation, stage1_steps=20 is beneficial. stage1_steps=25 crashes with low_ram+hq+distilled LoRA.

stage1_steps=25 with --hq and --low-ram causes FileNotFoundError: distilled LoRA is incompatible with this combination. The low_ram+hq+distilled LoRA path resolution fails at step count 25. Avoid --low-ram with --hq when using distilled LoRA, or keep stage1_steps<=20.
